input.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return/deletion obligation in Section 17
input.comment: [Playbook] We added an exit clause so that, on any termination or expiry, Garman provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates and returns our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days before certifying deletion. The Agreement currently has no data return or transition mechanic, which leaves us exposed on exit; we can accept a 90-day assistance period if six months is not workable.

ops.text: (d) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall (1) at Sparkling's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Garman's then-current rates; (2) within thirty (30) calendar days of such expiry or termination, return to Sparkling all of Sparkling's data in Garman's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (3) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Sparkling in writing.
